name: Farmer Mrs. Synakowski
description: I made this sweater for my neighbor in mind. 2 seasons to make. This sweater is made of variegated cotton yarn. Has BELL sleeves and a fringe hem with wooden beads. Fits 2X-4X or 22-28. This was made for someone tall with long arms! My Tall Queens struggle with sleeves never being long enough 😠! Peaches and cream and coral and pinks for Mrs S. Gorgeous Redhead she is and knows how to run a farm!! BOTH are Adirondack Chic. Use Code SEW at checkout 😉
